message.reasoning_content: Round 3 action. Need influence for presidency. I'm influence 1, rival 0 has 2. But I keep presidency via tie_order? Holder determined by max influence; rival 0 has 2 > mine 1, so I'd lose presidency unless I bribe 5M for influence 2, tying at 2 — tie_order [1,0,2] gives me priority. Bribe 5 to idx0 costs 5 alashi but regains presidency (veto, 5% bank bonus, 30% roof). Worth it. Then produce would be better, but action used. Choose bribe 5 to 0 (choice 4).
